fields.placeholder: Whether you are a tourism supplier, destination organisation, distributor or booking system partner, contact TXA to find the right pathway for your organisation.

fields.label: Pathway 1 Copy

fields.placeholder: If you have tours, accommodation, or attractions, choose 'General Enquiry' or contact your current booking system provider to see if they are already integrated with TXA.

fields.label: Pathway 2 Copy

fields.placeholder: OTAs and wholesalers looking for high quality bookable Australian inventory should select 'Distributor Enquiry' to start the technical evaluation process.

fields.label: Pathway 3 Copy
fields.name: contact_pathway_3_copy
fields.placeholder: Regional and State bodies should request the 'Smart Destination Demo' to understand the strategic benefits of our destination wide aggregation.

fields.label: Pathway 4 Copy

fields.placeholder: Tech providers wanting to offer their clients global distribution via TXA should select 'Booking-System Partner' for API documentation access.
